style.size: constraint: this node's size inside a vstack/hstack (e.g. length:1). On a $each node it applies to every item

list.description: Vertical list, optional selected row. An item is a string or {text, fg, bg, bold...} for a colored row. scroll:true (needs id) makes it scrollable

chart.description: Line chart with axes. Each series is {name, data: [[x, y], ...], fg}; axis bounds follow the data

calendar.description: Month calendar. Highlights listed days (reverse video, or the given colour)

canvas.description: Free-form drawing on an x/y plane. shapes: line {x1,y1,x2,y2}, rect {x,y,w,h}, circle {x,y,r}, points {coords:[[x,y]]}, map {resolution: low|high}, text {x,y,text}; each takes fg

table.description: Table with optional header. A row is a string[] or {cells: string[], fg, bg, bold...} for a colored row. scroll:true (needs id) makes it scrollable

popup.description: Centered overlay on the whole frame; place last

bindings: Any prop value may be {"$state":"/json/pointer"}: replaced by that value from live state. A missing path drops the prop (the widget uses its default).
In a "children" array, {"$each":"/array","template":{...}} repeats the template for each array item. Inside the template, {"$item":"/field"} reads a field of the current item.
Any node may carry "$if":"/path": it renders only when that state value is truthy (not null, false, 0, "" or empty).
Numeric props like selected, ratio and data take numbers, not strings.

{"$pick":{"of":{"$state":"/pct"},"rules":[[">=90","red"],[">=70","yellow"]],"else":"green"}} evaluates to the value of the first matching rule. Rules compare numbers (>=, <=, >, <, ==, !=; a trailing % is ignored) or text (==, !=). Use it anywhere a value goes, e.g. "fg".
Scrollable widgets (scroll:true plus a unique id): Tab moves focus, j/k or arrows scroll a line, PgUp/PgDn a page, g/G jump to top/bottom.
